## Documentation Rules
Whenever asked to write or update product documentation:
1. Output in Markdown (.md) format.
2. Map Android concepts clearly:
    - Activities/Composables -> UI/UX Features
    - ViewModels -> Business Logic
    - Repositories -> Data Management
    - Room DB / Retrofit -> Persistence & API Integrations
3. Maintain a file named `PRODUCT_KNOWLEDGE.md` in the repo root.
